messages:
mike_support: Escalation: EmberHealth (tenant ember-71) reporting bulk embed ingestion failures after API key rotation. Case #9920. Renewal in 12 days. Customer says onboarding pipelines are blocked.

 tara_csm: Yikes. Can you paste the error they see and whether we rolled back?

 mike_support: Error snippet from their logs:
 ```
 500 ingest_error tenant=ember-71 reason=invalid_signature
 model=embedder-v2 request_id=rid_9f8e7d
 ```
 We tried a rollback of the key rotation but some producer hosts still fail intermittently.

 leo_se: They're on Dedicated (ap-southeast-2). Root cause: some producer nodes cached the old key fingerprint; rotation created new signatures that failed validation. I have a hotfix to force key refresh across producers (no downtime, ~5m coordination for cache purge).

 tara_csm: Got it. I'll coordinate a maintenance window. Customer asked for a written comms plan and a goodwill gesture since this delays their pilot go-live. Looping @ethan_sales for renewal context.

 ethan_sales: Please offer a tailored credit — theyre a mid-market pilot; suggest 3 weeks onboarding credit + one hour of priority engineering office hours. Also flag in CRM as renewal-watch.

 ops-bot: key-refresh job scheduled at 2025-07-12T09:05:00Z.

 leo_se: Key-refresh executed at 2025-07-12T09:06:12Z. Error-rate for embed requests dropped from ~18% to ~0.9%. Still validating batch ingestion.

 tara_csm: Draft comms to EmberHealth (short):
 - apology + brief cause summary (API key rotation + stale host cache)
 - immediate mitigations we performed (rollback attempt + forced key refresh)
 - short-term plan: completed refresh, monitoring for 24h; proposed follow-up health-check call tomorrow
 - offer: 3 weeks onboarding credit + 60m priority SE office hours (per ethan_sales)
 - contact: tara_csm + leo_se
 I'll send after you confirm logs, @mike_support.

 mike_support: Logs attached to case. Two residual failures in queue noted, clearing them now.

 leo_se: Running tenant-wide validation now; will post final validation report within 3 hours.

 tara_csm: Action items:
 - tara_csm: send comms + cc ethan_sales (in 30m)
 - leo_se: full validation report & attach logs (3h)
 - mike_support: update support ticket and flag for CS follow-up
 - ethan_sales: update CRM renewal-watch and prepare credit approval note

 mike_support: Marking support -> CS handoff complete. Customer calmer after the refresh but wants formal follow-up.

 tara_csm: :white_check_mark: Will post comms and schedule the follow-up call.
